purpose: Teach: パワフル/備わっ/チョイス/分量/健闘/切り離し/編著/有数

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、パワフルな営業体制を組め
lines.en: Build us a stronger sales structure.
lines.style: Measured authority. Direct eye contact. Clean attack on each instruction. No softness—this is a directive, not a suggestion. Shoulder-back posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人にも実力が備わってきました
lines.en: Yes, sir. The new hires are developing real capability.
lines.style: Respectful and steady. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Even pacing. Not defensive—offering progress as fact, not apology. Attentive but not fawning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、戦略のチョイスは慎重にしろ
lines.en: But be careful with strategic choices.
lines.style: Weight on 'careful.' Slight lean forward. Lower register than the first statement—this is a correction, not an order. Deliberate pace. The tone that means he's seen mistakes before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仕入れの分量を再検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review our supply quantities.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Not rushing to prove anything. Clean acknowledgment without elaboration. Slight exhale that lands the words. Professional, not grateful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合との健闘を期待する
lines.en: I expect strong performance against the competition.
lines.style: Simple and final. No inflection that softens it. Stated as expectation, not hope. Brief pause before the final phrase—he means this.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い慣習を組織から切り離します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll cut the old patterns out of our structure.
lines.style: Firm agreement. No hedging. The words land with intent. Shoulders back slightly, showing he's heard and understood the weight of it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: We also need to move the company history project forward.
lines.style: Calm authority. Not urgent—this is long-term vision. Measured pacing. The tone of someone building legacy, not just hitting quarterly targets.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社は業界有数の存在になります
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're going to become an industry leader.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. No strain in the voice. The final statement—almost to himself but audible. Steady eye contact. This lands as a promise.
